name: gbrain
role: sidecar knowledge brain beside the world tools; not a harness under test

gbrain.branch: capy/gbra188-brain-first-instructions (gbrain#7489, open and unmerged on 2026-10-25 21:40Z; the branch head after internal-task revised the installer with a per-turn hook on each harness: an OpenClaw before_prompt_build plugin and a Hermes pre_llm_call hook)
gbrain.previous: 173743622b5d9e4637369278bb43046806f25280 (0.60.452.0, master, the merge of gbrain#7481) for run gbrain-scoped-2026-10, which executes from a worktree at its own preregistration commit 5caeee6f and keeps that pin; 99294fe4b13a93e7ec2830ea1beefbd76f3dd45e (0.60.444.0, gbrain#7489 before the hook revision) for run gbrain-installer-2026-10; 089bf0d848b50b0ac8be756f3363af5401fce1a1 (0.60.431.0, master, 2026-10-24) for runs company-brain-2026-10, gbrain-ladder-2026-10 and gbrain-verbs-2026-10, whose receipts name it; f241216c133771545bd93e97874f859366b3ef8d (0.60.413.0) for run gbrain-arm-2026-10
gbrain.pinned_for: run gbrain-installer-hook-2026-10 (internal-task): the installer rung needs gbrain setup openclaw and gbrain setup hermes with the per-turn hook outputs (the gbrain-turn-rule plugin, the Hermes hooks block and allowlist), which only gbrain#7489 at this head writes; the pull request head may move again and later heads are not what this pin names

corpus.slice: bot-visible brains (world/seed/world.json): source_slugs of non-DM channels loaded for the split plus files with visibility public loaded for the split; company brains: every channel and DM page, every file, every email and every meeting loaded for the split; page slug <split>/<corpus slug> in both

surface: starter (default; the cell's gbrain.surface picks starter or verbs, internal-task)

embeddings.default: off (gbrain init --no-embedding; import --no-embed): search is keyword-only and the brain makes no model or embedding call
embeddings.not_gbrain_default: gbrain's new-install default is voyage:voyage-4; this repository has no Voyage key, so the embedded brains use gbrain's documented OpenAI alternative, priced in runner/pricing/embedding-pricing.ts at $0.02 per million tokens
embeddings.route: requests leave through OPENAI_BASE_URL only, pointing at the metering proxy's slot URL (http://host.docker.internal:<port>/<slot>/openai); gbrain treats a configured base URL as satisfying the OpenAI key requirement and sends Bearer unauthenticated; the proxy injects the key on the host and meters each /v1/embeddings call; no key in the container or the build
embeddings.build: scripts/build-gbrain-image.sh --embedded: the builder stage run as a container with /brain bind-mounted, build-brain.ts --embeddings <model> (init --embedding-model, import, embed --stale --catch-up --json --yes), the proxy's usage summary written into the brain's manifest.json, then the embedded Dockerfile target
embeddings.brains: /brains/dev-embedded and /brains/heldout-embedded, bot-visible only; served when the cell's gbrain.embeddings names the model (HE_GBRAIN_EMBEDDINGS)
embeddings.query_embed_timeout_note: GBRAIN_QUERY_EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS the entrypoint sets for an embedded brain (gbrain's default is 6000): past it gbrain continues keyword-only and stamps search_degraded, so a semantic trial with a degraded stamp is excluded (HE-GBRAIN-005, runner); the value is above the proxy round trip measured in the ladder's smoke at parallel 3

model_calls: none from a keyword brain; an embedded brain embeds each search, query or recall query through OPENAI_BASE_URL (the metering proxy), metered per trial; the sidecar environment carries no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY

serve_env.GBRAIN_HOME: /brain (a per-trial copy of /brains/$HE_GBRAIN_SPLIT; the brain records absolute paths, so it is served where it was built)
serve_env.GBRAIN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: 64 random hex characters minted per trial, never written anywhere
serve_env.GBRAIN_REMOTE_PRIVATE_PAGES: 1 for a company brain only (HE_GBRAIN_BRAIN=company); unset for bot-visible
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_BRAIN: bot-visible | company: which /brains entry the entrypoint copies to /brain
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_SCOPE: none | member: with member the entrypoint also copies the company brain's tokens.json to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT for the world's tap, which presents the requesting member's token per turn
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_SURFACE: starter | verbs: the --surface the entrypoint passes to gbrain serve (internal-task)
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_EMBEDDINGS: off | openai:text-embedding-3-small: with a model the entrypoint serves /brains/<split>-embedded and requires OPENAI_BASE_URL (internal-task)
serve_env.OPENAI_BASE_URL: the metering proxy slot URL, embedded brains only; a route, never a key

auth: gbrain auth create trial-<trial id>; the bearer token gbrain_<hex> goes to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT/token (mode 0600) and nowhere else; only the world's /gbrain tap presents it; under scope member the tap presents the requesting member's build-time token from tokens.json instead, and public-only before the first turn
wire: POST /mcp, Authorization: Bearer <token>, Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; replies are SSE-framed JSON-RPC (event: message / data: {...}); GET /mcp is 405; /health is unauthenticated
image: harness-eval/gbrain:dev (gbrain/Dockerfile, built from the repository root with -f gbrain/Dockerfile or scripts/build-gbrain-image.sh); /brains/dev, /brains/heldout, /brains/dev-company and /brains/heldout-company with manifest.json each (tokens.json beside the company brains), /install (the install bundle, internal-task); the embedded target adds /brains/dev-embedded and /brains/heldout-embedded; the company-brain run builds the same Dockerfile as harness-eval/gbrain:company and passes --gbrain-image so the gbrain arm's :dev tag is untouched while that arm runs
reaches: the host loopback only, through a published port; the harness container reaches gbrain only through the world's POST /gbrain tap

brains.bot-visible: /brains/<split>: one default source, built by gbrain/build-brain.ts --brain bot-visible (the gbrain arm)
brains.company: /brains/<split>-company: one federated gbrain source per distinct reader set (public, private-<member>, team-<short>, team-<short>-members, channel-<name>, readers-<8 hex>), every source created with gbrain sources add <id> --path <staging dir> --force --federated and imported with gbrain import <dir> --source <id> --no-embed --allow-noncanonical-root --json; one bearer token per employee and agent (auth create member-<id>; auth rescope --token member-<id> --sources private-<id>,<every source whose readers include the member>) plus public-only (--sources public), the secrets in tokens.json (mode 0600 in the brain directory; world-readable inside the image layer, which is built and used on one machine and never pushed to a registry); served with GBRAIN_REMOTE_PRIVATE_PAGES=1 so visibility: private pages are served like every other page (gbrain's default hides them from every remote caller; internal-task report)

starter.note: the gbrain arm's surface; search is keyword-only on a keyword brain and every result carries gbrain's degraded_recall notice; recall is present here too

verbs.note: gbrain's memory-verb surface (docs/protocol/MEMORY_VERBS_v1.md); recall returns an object whose results carry slug; synthesize always errors without a chat key, counted as a gbrain error and stated as a difference from a keyed install; no get_page, search or query

surfaces.verified_by: tools/list through the sidecar at the pinned commit (tests/gbrain-image.test.ts with HE_GBRAIN_IMAGE set)

install.bundle: /install in the image, built by gbrain/build-install.ts at image build with no key; manifest.json lists every file's sha256 and the kept slugs of each compiled context; gbrain/export-install.sh exports one harness and split view with its own manifest (view_digest)

openclaw.doc: docs/mcp/OPENCLAW.md (openclaw mcp add; the world's tap stands in for the server command, as the gbrain arm already does) and INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md step 5
openclaw.writes: <workspace>/skills: the five core skills (brain-ops, capture, data-loss-gate, query, resolve-before-asking) in 30 files at this commit (gbrain#7508's openclaw_core_scaffold default since 0.60.456.0; 64 skills in 127 files at 17374362 and earlier), including conventions/brain-first.md
openclaw.lands_at: /workspace/skills, OpenClaw's configured workspace, copied by harnesses/openclaw/adapter.sh under HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL=gbrain-docs

hermes.doc: docs/mcp/HERMES.md (register the server; gbrain compile-context --target hermes --include-core writes the always-loaded core memory Hermes's prompt builder reads from the cwd) and INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md step 5 (cd <workspace> && gbrain skillpack scaffold --all)
hermes.writes: <workspace>/skills (the full bundle, 64 skills in 127 files, unchanged by gbrain#7508) and .hermes.md: every page of the split as slug, title and an excerpt (dev 18 pages, about 700 tokens; held-out 25 pages, about 940 tokens; the eval brains have no core pages, so the index is what --include-core adds)
hermes.lands_at: /workspace/skills and /workspace/.hermes.md, copied by harnesses/hermes/adapter.sh under HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL=gbrain-docs; whether Hermes loads either is recorded from the smoke in harnesses/hermes/pin.json
hermes.explicit_workspace: the docs' cd form does not resolve an empty directory at this commit, so --workspace is passed

installer.turn_hook_expected_note: the pinned installer writes the per-turn hook (gbrain#7489 at 10949a15); the runner's preflight refuses an installer view without installer.turn_hook (HE-GBRAIN-006), so a block-only image cannot run the hook rung. Set false for a block-only pin.
installer.rung: installer (gbrain.install: gbrain-installer, internal-task, gbrain#7489): gbrain's own installer writes the brain-first instruction block into the harness's instruction file; the MCP registration stays the eval's, as on every rung
installer.availability: both at this pin (10949a15, gbrain#7489's head, 0.60.457.0), where run gbrain-installer-hook-2026-10 measures the rung with the per-turn hook; both at 99294fe4 (gbrain#7489 before the hook revision), where run gbrain-installer-2026-10 measured the block-only rung; none at 17374362 (master at 0.60.452.0, which has no gbrain setup openclaw or hermes); gbrain/build-install.ts records harnesses.<h>.installer.unavailable with gbrain's own words when the commit has no setup target and an installer cell then fails preflight (HE-GBRAIN-006)

openclaw.writes: <workspace>/AGENTS.md: the brain-first block between gbrain:brain-first markers (1013 bytes at 10949a15, 1002 at 99294fe4), a new file when the workspace has none; at 10949a15 also the per-turn hook plugin state/gbrain/gbrain-turn-rule/{index.js,openclaw.plugin.json,package.json} (turn_hook.action print: gbrain prints the three openclaw commands the adapter then runs)
openclaw.lands_at: /workspace/AGENTS.md, copied by harnesses/openclaw/adapter.sh under HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL=gbrain-installer; OpenClaw loads it as a workspace bootstrap file (agents.defaults.skipBootstrap: true stops only the seeding of its own bootstrap files), proved in tests/adapter-install.test.ts against a fake model endpoint

hermes.seed: gbrain appends the block to an existing non-empty SOUL.md and writes nothing into an empty HERMES_HOME (start Hermes once, it seeds SOUL.md); the image build seeds <home>/SOUL.md with Hermes's own SOUL.md at harnesses/hermes/pin.json's commit, sha256 in that pin's soul_md and in the bundle manifest
hermes.writes: <home>/SOUL.md: the seed followed by the block (667 + 1012 bytes at 10949a15, 667 + 1001 at 99294fe4); at 10949a15 also the per-turn hook (turn_hook.action write): the hooks block in <home>/config.yaml and its approval in <home>/shell-hooks-allowlist.json
hermes.lands_at: $HERMES_HOME/SOUL.md (/harness-state/hermes/SOUL.md), copied by harnesses/hermes/adapter.sh, which replaces the default SOUL.md Hermes itself seeded when the adapter ran hermes --version only if its sha256 equals the recorded seed (gbrain-install.json replaced_seed)

excluded.openclaw_context_engine_plugin: docs/mcp/OPENCLAW.md's first shape, the gbrain-context-engine bundle plugin, runs gbrain as a stdio subprocess inside the harness and takes over OpenClaw's context-engine slot; excluded because it bypasses the world tap, so no gbrain call would reach events.jsonl and nothing would be gradable (TODOS.md: a tapped stdio bridge)
excluded.qm: gbrain documents no install path for QM, so the docs rung does not exist for it

gbrain_check.note: the image accepts any commit through the GBRAIN_COMMIT build arg (a full sha or a branch; shallow fetch); GBRAIN_VERSION is checked only when set; /opt/sidecar/image.json records the resolved commit and the checkout's VERSION; scripts/gbrain-check.ts builds harness-eval/gbrain:check-<sha12> through scripts/build-gbrain-image.sh
